title: Super small desk fan.  NOT an air conditioner
text: Super small desk fan.  NOT an air conditioner. This fan is the size of your hand.  Suitable only on a desk to blow in your face.  It s quiet and blows a little air.  Don't expect much.  This is NOT an air conditioner by any stretch of the imagination.
